intent: Attach a proving test to the reviewed rule agent-daily-spend-cap-is-operator-adjustable-under-a-ceiling, whose reviewing package is no longer in the repository.
observable_outcome: coverage lists agent-daily-spend-cap-is-operator-adjustable-under-a-ceiling as proven, and get-record names the obligation that proves it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A platform agent's effective daily spend cap is the operator's override when one is set, otherwise the default its definition declares. An override must be above zero and at most US$5 a day, and re-registering the definitions replaces only the default, never the override.
